notes: The pod stills of the sea hull walk-on and helm: the lighterman's longboat moored bow-on to the pier (Lighter Flotilla, by day). The player stands on the pier at the stem; E walks aboard (over the stem, aft along the side deck beside the cabin, to the helm), E casts off, W held. The reader checks: no leap and no figure ghosting through the cabin, the camera clear of the cabin roof at the helm, hands on the hull's own steering, no oar.

steps.name: board
steps.transition: E on the pier at the moored hull's stem: the player walks aboard; the still is taken mid-walk

steps.name: cast-off
steps.transition: E aboard: the hull casts off

steps.name: underway
steps.transition: W held: the player at the paddle or the helm, the hull under way; the still is taken with W still held
